steps.label: 3007-own-paper1094-add-modal-dom-click
command: (()=>{if(location.pathname!=='/paper/modify.donga'||new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('paperId')!=='1094')throw Error('Own paper only');const m=document.querySelector('#paperItemAddModal');if(m.classList.contains('show'))throw Error('Already open');const b=document.querySelector('[data-bs-target="#paperItemAddModal"]');if(!b||b.disabled)throw Error('Missing add action');b.click();return {clicked:true,modalClass:m.className};})()

steps.label: 3009-own-paper1094-set242-search-input
command: (()=>{const m=document.querySelector('#paperItemAddModal');if(!m.classList.contains('show'))throw Error('Modal not open');const k=m.querySelector('input[name=keyword]');if(m.querySelector('[name=keywordType]').value!=='itemId')throw Error('Expected item ID filter');k.value='2089242';k.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));const b=m.querySelector('button[hx-get="/paper/item-search.donga"]');b.click();return {keyword:k.value,checkedStatuses:[...m.querySelectorAll('[name=statuses]:checked')].map(e=>e.value)};})()
